claim: Fixes which way the air travels so hair, cloth and particles agree from shot to shot instead of contradicting each other across a cut. Swirling and updraft are also character beats — one traps a figure, the other lifts them.
method: identical subject sentence and seed in every panel; only the option clause changes. panels marked control render the untouched subject, because SDXL cannot express absence.

panels.clause: wind blowing to the right, hair swept right, cloth trailing right
wind blowing to the left, hair swept left, cloth trailing left
wind blowing toward viewer, hair blown back, cloth pressed against body
wind blowing away from viewer, hair blown forward, cloth billowing away
swirling wind, vortex, debris circling, hair whirling
updraft, wind from below, hair blown upward, clothes lifting
